description:
Dopest possible La Roca ever conceived..

Tri-plane. The unhavable. The real deal. This one's cerakoted pewter which is super gangster. , paragon steerer and dropouts, 3d waterjet cro-moly plates…heat treated. Waltworks custom drawn .8/1.2 lightweight blades. These forks are no longer produced and got pretty expensive ($1400 +cerekote). and dope addition to any hardcore monē enthusiast build.

E13 bronze cranks/chainring are perfect with wolf tooth pedals…hot bronze on bronze action.

The dopest wheels i9 makes. Hydra hubs to their carbon enduro rim. It's what I would pick if I was feel flush. Super fast hub on the single speed is a perfect match .

Pewter Paul post, Paul 35mm pewter stem. Turbo oddmonē. It's the sickest cockpit and component list ever made for a La Roca

The brakes! 4 pot dhr evos or for winning world cup downhill…or feeling perfectly buff brakes for normal people that look insane with that copper finish.. The matching oaks levers are like $140 themselves ..but this build deserves to be the dopest possible…no excuses…also they feel amazing. I've recently become a “levers close to bars” convert and these levers deliver. Huge power. Perfect feel. Superior grip on the bars. Finish match is insanely cool. Give it to me.

Clean brooks with silver accent logo is perfect with the tan sidewalls terrevail 2.6s and the supacush diety grips. I'm telling you… you gotta feel this setup with the steel fork and oddmonē and plump tires and grips… p cushy rigid bike.

The perfect ratio with the 22t endless cog.. you gotta ride this… feels glorious. Custom etched monē cassette spacers.

Point is… this thing drips monē…if you want a full steel brazed monē with a tri-plane..this could be the opportunity.

XL with 474 reach. Shorty 35mm stem and 15degree sweep oddmonēs. I'm 5’8” and I could almost get down with this thing. I'd say 5’9-6’1 or 2 with the bars rotated forwrd a smidge. A 50mm or 70mm Paul could be arranged for someone bigger.
